overview.lead: Druids tank, heal or deal damage by changing form. Blizzard describes their healing as heals over time that need planning, and in Forever most potions, weapon enchants and procs work in form.

points.text: Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack each improve every type of critical strike, and only one of them can apply, so a raid with both a Balance and a Feral Druid chooses one.
Several Classic talents are now baseline spells: Nature's Grasp, Omen of Clarity, Faerie Fire (Feral) and Improved Mark of the Wild. Berserk, Tiger's Fury and Gift of the Earthmother are gone.
Restoration's new capstone is Wild Growth on row 7, a heal over time for the target's whole party.

101.summary: What every Druid should know before choosing a spec: what Forever changed, the form quests and the racial choice.

steps.text: Drink potions without leaving form: most potions and consumables work in form, Rage potions and Thistletea included, and Mana Potions again since 8 Oct.
Choose your weapon for its damage even as a Feral Druid: form auto-attacks use your weapon's DPS, and weapon enchants and procs work in form.
Learn the new baseline spells as you level: Nature's Grasp at 10, Revive at 12 and Omen of Clarity at 20.
Look for Furor in Feral Combat and Heart of the Wild in Restoration: the two talents swapped trees.
Use Hurricane freely on packs: it has no cooldown in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Shifting out of Cat or Bear Form to drink a potion.
mistakes.fix: Most potions and consumables work in form, so stay in it.

mistakes.mistake: Following a Classic build that spends points on Nature's Grasp or Omen of Clarity.
mistakes.fix: Both are gone from the Balance tree and are baseline spells now.

mistakes.mistake: Planning around Berserk or Tiger's Fury.
mistakes.fix: Both were removed in Forever.

steps.text: At level 10, start 'Heeding the Call' in Darnassus. It sends you to the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade and teaches Bear Form, Growl and Maul.
Keep Teleport: Moonglade, which the Moonglade step of that quest gives you.
At level 14, 'Lessons Anew' teaches Cure Poison.
At level 16, 'A Lesson to Learn' leads through a set of trials to the 'Aquatic Form' quest.
At level 20, recover the relics from the Stormrage Barrow Den in Moonglade, then finish 'Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit' and 'To Darnassus' to learn Cat Form, Claw, Prowl and Rip.

mistakes.mistake: Waiting for the trainer to teach Cat Form.
mistakes.fix: Cat Form is no longer simply trained: it comes from 'The Great Cat Spirit' chain at level 20.

mistakes.mistake: Skipping the level 10 Bear Form quest.
mistakes.fix: It teaches Bear Form, Growl and Maul and gives you Teleport: Moonglade.

overview.lead: Balance is the Druid caster spec: Arcane and Nature damage from range, with Moonkin Form at the bottom of the tree raising the crit chance of party and raid members near you by 3%.

points.text: Insect Swarm sits on row 4: damage over time that also lowers the target's chance to hit by 2%. Eclipse, new in Forever, lets each Wrath speed up your next 2 Starfires.
In Classic 1.12, Balance was weak in raids and mainly brought for its spell-crit aura. In Forever, Moonkin Aura's crit bonus applies to all attacks and spells.

101.summary: Leveling as Balance, the core rotation and the habits that keep you alive.

steps.text: Improved Wrath cuts Wrath's cast time by 0.1 sec and its Mana cost by 10% at rank 1, up to 0.5 sec and 50% at rank 5.
Nature's Splendor sits on row 3 and requires Nature's Majesty; Insect Swarm sits on row 4.
Improved Entangling Roots lets a rooted enemy take 25% more damage at rank 1, and 75% at rank 3, before the root breaks. Entangling Roots now works indoors.
Nature's Grasp is a baseline spell at 10 that works in forms and indoors, so it is your escape while you level.

mistakes.mistake: Spending points on Nature's Grasp or Improved Thorns from a Classic build.
mistakes.fix: Both are gone from the Balance tree, and Nature's Grasp is now a baseline spell.

mistakes.mistake: Saving points for Nature's Splendor without taking Nature's Majesty.
mistakes.fix: Nature's Splendor requires Nature's Majesty.

steps.text: Put Insect Swarm on targets that live long enough: it deals its damage over 12 sec and lowers their chance to hit by 2%.
Cast Wrath to bank Eclipse charges, then spend them on Starfire. Each Wrath speeds up your next 2 Starfires, you can store up to 4 charges, and they last 15 sec.
Stay in Moonkin Form once you have it: it raises Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, but you cannot cast healing spells in it.
A non-periodic spell crit triggers Nature's Grace, which speeds up your casting and shortens your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.
Use Hurricane on large packs: it has no cooldown in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Letting Eclipse charges run out.
mistakes.fix: They last 15 sec, so follow a run of Wrath casts with Starfire before they expire.

mistakes.mistake: Trying to heal yourself in Moonkin Form.
mistakes.fix: Moonkin Form prevents the use of healing spells.

steps.text: Omen of Clarity is a baseline spell from level 20. Keep it active: Moonkin Form raises its chance to trigger by 100%.
Thorns now scales with spell power.
Moonkin Form raises the armor you get from items by 360%, which helps when an enemy reaches you.
Moonkin Form also protects you from Polymorph, and shifting into it frees you of Polymorph and movement-impairing effects.
Keep Rebirth (20) and Innervate (40) on your bars.

mistakes.mistake: Standing in a slow or root you could shift out of.
mistakes.fix: Shifting into Moonkin Form frees you of movement-impairing effects.

steps.text: Crit feeds three Balance talents: Nature's Majesty adds 4% crit at rank 2, Vengeance raises your crit damage bonus, and Nature's Grace speeds up your casts after a crit.
Nature's Reach gives 4% hit and 20% more range for your offensive Balance spells at rank 2 of 2.
Treat Forever's spell hit cap as unknown: Icy Veins says there is one but its value is not known yet. In the Classic reference, casters needed 16% against raid bosses three levels higher.
Moonglow cuts the Mana cost of your damaging spells by up to 25%.
Nature's Splendor makes Moonfire last 3 sec longer and Insect Swarm 2 sec longer.

overview.lead: Feral tanks in Bear Form and deals melee damage in Cat Form. Leader of the Pack raises the crit chance of party or raid members within 45 yards by 3% and is exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

points.text: Choose the Bear or Cat path for the job you do most: Primal Bite follows Leader of the Pack and Shifting Power follows Predatory Discipline, both on row 7.
Weapon enchants, procs and most potions now work in form, and form auto-attacks use your weapon's DPS, so your weapon matters.

101.summary: Leveling as Feral, the core Cat and Bear rotations and the Rage and Energy habits that matter first.

steps.text: Bear Form, Growl and Maul come from the level 10 class quest; Cat Form, Claw, Prowl and Rip come from the level 20 chain.
Feral Swiftness makes you 30% faster in Cat Form and adds 4% dodge at rank 2 of 2.
Thick Hide adds base armor in Bear, Cat, Dire Bear and Moonkin Form.
Lacerate is a one-point talent on row 4 and requires Savage Fury.
Cats learn Poised at level 32: start a fight from full Energy to save 10 Energy on your next Energy ability.

mistakes.mistake: Saving a point for Lacerate without taking Savage Fury.
mistakes.fix: Lacerate requires Savage Fury.

mistakes.mistake: Leveling with an old weapon because you fight in form.

steps.text: Cat: open from Prowl. Feral Instinct makes you harder to detect while Prowling.
Cat: Savage Fury adds 10% to Claw, Rake and Shred damage at rank 2, and Shredding Attacks cuts Shred's Energy cost by 18 at rank 3.
Cat: Blizzard raised the base damage and attack-power scaling of Rip and Rake, and Rend and Tear adds up to 15% to your melee abilities against bleeding targets.
Bear: Lacerate makes the target bleed, causes a high amount of threat and stacks up to 5 times.
Bear: Primal Bite, on row 7, costs 20 Rage, has a 6 sec cooldown and generates a high amount of threat.

mistakes.mistake: Letting Lacerate drop after one application.

steps.text: Rage Potions and Thistletea now work for Druids, and most potions work in form.

Furor at rank 5 gives you 10 Rage every time you shift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, and restores the Energy you had when you return to Cat Form.
Later beta notes doubled Rage from crits, so crit feeds your Rage in Bear Form.

overview.lead: Restoration heals mostly with heals over time: Rejuvenation, Regrowth and, on row 7, Wild Growth, which heals the target's party quickly at first and more slowly over 7 sec.

points.text: Rejuvenation, Tranquility and Wild Growth can crit since 24 Sep, and Swiftmend leaves the heal over time it draws on in place.
Blizzard calls Druid healing less versatile than a Priest's and built on planning, so put heals over time out before the damage lands.

101.summary: Leveling as Restoration, the core healing rotation and the mana habits that matter first.

steps.text: Bloom heals the target for 100% of your Spirit when your Rejuvenation or Regrowth expires, and for 50% if it is dispelled.
Swiftmend sits on row 4. Nature's Swiftness, on row 5, requires Naturalist.

steps.text: Keep Rejuvenation or Regrowth on the targets taking steady damage: Swiftmend and Bloom both work from them.
Swiftmend instantly heals a target that has your Rejuvenation or Regrowth for the full duration of that effect, on a 15 sec cooldown, and the heal over time keeps running.
Use Wild Growth when a whole party takes damage: it heals the target and their party, quickly at first and more slowly over 7 sec.
Nature's Swiftness makes your next Nature spell instant on a 3 min cooldown, so save it for emergencies.
Tranquility arrives at 30. Improved Tranquility cuts its threat by 100% and its cooldown by 60% at rank 2.

Improved Mark of the Wild is now baseline, and Gift of the Wild arrives at 50.

steps.text: Spirit does two jobs: Bloom heals for 100% of your Spirit at natural expiry, and Reflection keeps up to 50% of your Mana regeneration going while you cast.
Rejuvenation, Tranquility and Wild Growth can crit since 24 Sep, so crit now adds to your heals over time.
Improved Rejuvenation raises Rejuvenation's effect by up to 15%.
Wild Growth's base cast time is 3 seconds; Naturalist shortens it by up to 0.5 seconds.

mistakes.mistake: Dropping crit because heals over time used to ignore it.
mistakes.fix: Rejuvenation, Tranquility and Wild Growth can crit since 24 Sep.

steps.text: Get healing potions from First Aid crafters: Warcraft Tavern says they moved from Alchemy to First Aid.
Flasks are brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object.
Profession camps grant slightly weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones, and you must sit at the camp for at least 1 minute.
Read the Classic healer kit (Flask of Distilled Wisdom, Elixir of the Sages, Major Mana Potion and the rest) as a Classic reference, not a Forever-checked list.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting a camp buff to stack with the real class buff.
mistakes.fix: Camp copies do not stack with the real class buffs.

steps.text: Plan ahead: Druid healing relies on heals over time, so put them out before the damage lands.
Several Restoration Druids can share a raid: Warcraft Tavern says heals over time stack and crit, and a 16 Oct fix stops high-rank Rejuvenation from blocking another Druid's.
Keep Innervate (40) and Rebirth (20) ready, and cover poisons and curses with Abolish Poison (26) and Remove Curse (24).

mistakes.mistake: Waiting for damage to land before casting heals over time.
mistakes.fix: Blizzard describes Druid healing as heals over time that need planning, so cast them ahead of the damage.

steps.text: Swiftmend and Nature's Swiftness are your instant emergency heals: Swiftmend heals at once from your Rejuvenation or Regrowth, and Nature's Swiftness makes your next Nature spell instant.
Nature's Focus gives your Nature spells up to a 70% chance not to lose casting time when you are hit, at rank 5.
Nature's Grasp is baseline and works in forms and indoors, which gives you a way out.
Forms have been immune to Disarm since 1 Oct.

mistakes.mistake: Hard-casting a long heal while a melee player hits you.
mistakes.fix: Use Nature's Swiftness to make your next Nature spell instant.
